title: 015 提线傀儡夺龙珠016 三尸聚会方炼魂
content_zh:
：管明晦利用杨鲤的声音把崔海客引下来，他用黑眚丝把杨鲤手足反绑吊在洞顶最高处，施法封了嗓音，不令其发出半点声响。
接着再发动三套玄阴阵将石床连自己全部隐去。
崔海客进来以后，只见诺大的洞窟之中漆黑一片，双目虽然能够暗中视物，可空气里充满黑眚迷雾，并不能看出很远。
他也是小心谨慎的性子，右手掐着剑诀驾驭仙剑横在身前，左手掐指推算当前所遇到的局面。
卦象还未推演出来，便感受到杨鲤的存在，抬头看到被吊在洞顶的小徒弟正在向他疯狂摇头。
崔海客感受到此地万分凶险，但已经见到了受困的爱徒，不能不救！
他先张口喷出新炼成的鼍龙珠，悬在头顶，滴溜溜旋转，向周围喷洒出一圈圈黄色的光润，这些光华落下来，将他罩在里面。
仙剑加上宝珠，双重防护，料想即便有什么危险也足以应对了。
他看出绑着杨鲤的是左道之中很有名的黑眚丝，知道这种用邪法炼出来的东西，看似一股黑烟，仿佛打个喷嚏就能吹断，实则比钢筋铁丝韧性更强。
等闲的飞剑砍上去，非但无法将其斩断，还要受其污秽，被沾染失去灵性。
一般的法术也难以将其消灭，一着不慎，反被纠缠上来，沾身便中邪毒！
要破这类邪法，最好用的是峨眉、青城、五台、华山等中原剑仙大派的三昧真火，可惜他不会。
崔海客鼓荡丹田中的精气喷在剑上，他这剑品质不如杨鲤那口，只能用深厚的功力助涨其威力。
仙剑精芒暴涨，飞射出去，划过杨鲤上方吊人的黑眚丝，却是一晃而过。
杨鲤依旧吊在那里，冲他不断摇头。
崔海客这才反应过来，那是被人用法术制造出来的幻影假象。
他急道了声不好，就要收回飞剑，向后退去，准备先退到安全地带，搞清楚情况再来救人。
管明晦哪给他再来的机会，扬手发动阵法。
他如今总共有二十七面玄阴聚兽幡，分成三组小玄阴阵，再组合起来，形成一座玄阴炼魄阵。
随着神幡出现，凭空涌出大量黑烟，将全洞充满。

单独有九面神幡结成的小阵，把崔海客的飞剑困在里面，那剑精芒闪烁，四处飞射，俱被神幡挡了下来。
崔海客深陷滚滚浓烟之中，四面八方响起如雷般的兽吼，他想起昔年玄阴教主谷辰，善用玄阴聚兽之法，于此颇像，不禁心往下沉：
鲤儿不会惹上那个妖孽了吧？听说他自不量力，与峨眉派掌教长眉真人斗法被杀，已经数十年没有音信，难道竟然在这里么？
一念尚未转弯，早被玄阴阵颠倒五行，挪移空间，把他从洞口挪移到石床边。
只见滚滚黑煞之中，管明晦端坐在床上，双目之中红绿光芒爆闪，向他张口喷射出一股白惨惨的玄阴冷焰，射在鼍龙珠发出的护体黄光上面，激得白焰纷飞，黄光如水波般震动荡漾。
管明晦见对方宝珠品质不凡，自己腹中玄阴冷焰还不成气候，奈何不了对方，便又催动阵法，招来两面玄阴幡，将自己隐去。
崔海客也算眼疾手快，劈手打出一把飞针，化成六十四点光芒，宛如雨丝般向管明晦劈头盖脸打去。
两面玄阴聚兽幡将这些飞针挡住，幡上主神一条吹蚺张开口，先喷出粘稠黑烟，将这些针接住，然后向内倒吸，全部吸进肚子里。
另一个马熊，直接裹着一团黑气向崔海客扑过来，用头上的独角狠狠撞上他的护体黄光。
崔海客用旁门手段炼出来的飞针被吹蚺收走，顷刻间全被污染，失去灵性，无法召唤回来。
他急忙又打出一把碧绿色的飞刃，环身高速旋转，将四面八方欺过来的兽魂迫开，并将黑眚迷雾驱散。
content_en:
: Guan Minghui used Yang Li's voice to lure Cui Haike down. He tied Yang Li's hands and feet behind his back with black silk and hung him at the highest point of the cave ceiling. He cast a spell to silence his voice so that it would not make any sound.
Then he activated three sets of Xuanyin formations to hide the stone bed and himself.
After Cui Haike came in, he saw nothing but darkness in Nuo Da's cave. Although his eyes could see things in the dark, the air was full of black mist and he couldn't see very far.
He also has a cautious temperament. He holds the sword technique in his right hand to control the fairy sword in front of him, and uses his fingers in his left hand to calculate the current situation he is encountering.
Before the hexagram was deduced, he felt the presence of Yang Li. He looked up and saw the young apprentice hanging on the ceiling of the cave shaking his head crazily at him.
Cui Haike felt that this place was extremely dangerous, but he had already seen his beloved disciple who was trapped and had to save him!
He first opened his mouth and spat out the newly made dragon beads, hanging them above his head, spinning around, spraying circles of yellow luster around him, which fell down and covered him inside.
The fairy sword and the orb provide double protection. It is expected that even if there is any danger, it will be enough to deal with it.
He saw that the thing tied to the Yang Li was the famous black silk thread among the leftists. He knew that this thing made with evil methods looked like a puff of black smoke and seemed to be blown away by sneezing, but it was actually stronger than steel wire.
If a flying sword were to strike at it, not only would it not be able to cut it off, but it would also be contaminated by it and lose its spirituality.
It is difficult to eliminate it with ordinary magic. If you are not careful, it will be entangled and you will be poisoned!
To break this kind of evil spell, the best thing to use is the Samadhi True Fire of Emei, Qingcheng, Wutai, Huashan and other Central Plains Sword Immortal sects, but it's a pity that he doesn't know how to do it.
Cui Haike stirred up the essence in his Dantian and sprayed it on his sword. The quality of his sword was not as good as Yang Li's, so he could only use his profound skills to increase its power.
The magic light of the fairy sword surged and shot out, crossing the hanging black silk thread above Yang Li, but it passed by in a flash.
Yang Li was still hanging there, shaking his head at him.
Only then did Cui Haike realize that it was a phantom illusion created by someone using magic.
He hurriedly said no, and was about to retract the flying sword and retreat, preparing to retreat to a safe area first and figure out the situation before rescuing people.
Guan Minghui gave him another chance to activate the formation.
He now has a total of twenty-seven Xuanyin gathering beast banners, divided into three groups of small Xuanyin formations, and then combined to form a Xuanyin soul refining array.
As the sacred flag appeared, a large amount of black smoke poured out of thin air, filling the entire cave.
There was a small formation of nine-faced divine flags, trapping Cui Haike's flying sword. The sword flashed and flew in all directions, but was blocked by the divine flags.
Cui Haike was deep in the billowing smoke, and thunderous roars of beasts rang out from all directions. He thought of Gu Chen, the leader of Xuanyin in the past, who was good at using Xuanyin's method of gathering beasts. It was quite similar to this, and he couldn't help but feel sinking:
Li'er won't offend that monster, right? I heard that he overestimated his capabilities and was killed in a duel with Emei Sect leader Changmei Zhenren. There has been no news for decades. Could it be that he is here?
Before his thoughts could turn around, the Xuanyin Formation had already reversed the five elements, moved the space, and moved him from the entrance of the cave to the edge of the stone bed.
In the midst of the billowing darkness, Guan Minghui was sitting on the bed, with red and green light flashing in his eyes, and a stream of white Xuanyin cold flames was sprayed out of his mouth, hitting the body-protecting yellow light emitted by the dragon ball, causing the white flames to fly, and the yellow light to shake and ripple like water waves.
Guan Minghui saw that the other party's orb was of extraordinary quality and that the cold flames of Xuanyin in his belly were still weak, so he couldn't do anything to the other party, so he activated the formation and summoned two Xuanyin flags to hide himself.
Cui Haike also had quick eyesight and quick hands. He fired a flying needle from his hand, which turned into sixty-four points of light and hit Guan Minghui head and face like rain.
Two Xuanyin gathering beast flags blocked these flying needles. The main god on the flags opened his mouth, first sprayed out thick black smoke, caught the needles, and then sucked them inward, sucking them all into his stomach.
Another horse bear, directlyWrapped in a cloud of black energy, he rushed towards Cui Haike and slammed into his body-protecting yellow light with the horn on his head.
The flying needles that Cui Haike made by using other methods were taken away by the anaconda. They were all contaminated in an instant, lost their spirituality, and could not be summoned back.
He hurriedly fired another turquoise flying blade, spinning around at high speed, forcing away the beast souls that were attacking from all directions, and dispersing the black mist.
